summary: Atlantic International Corp filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Guus Franke as CEO and the transition of Jeffrey Jagid from CEO to President, effective June 29, 2026. The filing details an amendment to Jagid's employment agreement governing his new role as President; he remains a director. Franke, previously Executive Chairman, continues in that role. No financial terms, stake, premium, or advisor are disclosed. The change appears orderly rather than forced. The filing is routine disclosure of officer changes; no special-situation transaction is involved.
